description:
Flaccy plays the music you own at full quality: FLAC, ALAC, WAV, AIFF, MP3 and AAC. A real equalizer, gapless playback, synced lyrics you can share as a video, Last.fm scrobbling, a full iPad layout and a standalone Apple Watch app. No account, no ads, and your files never leave your device.

SEE EXACTLY WHAT YOU'RE HEARING
• Codec, bit depth and sample rate on every track, from CD quality to Hi-Res
• Gapless playback that honors your albums (exact for lossless files), with a queue that survives relaunches

A REAL EQUALIZER
• Drag the curve and hear it change, or switch to Advanced for up to ten bands with bells, shelves, filters and adjustable Q
• 16 presets and your own. Import Equalizer APO and AutoEq profiles to tune for your headphones
• A separate setting for every output: AirPods, a wired DAC, the speaker. Flaccy switches when you do
• Automatic headroom keeps boosts from clipping, and Hold to compare is level-matched, so louder never sounds better
• Works with every format and keeps playback gapless. Off or flat, the signal passes through untouched

YOUR LIBRARY, ORGANIZED
• Bring music in from the Files app, USB, a NAS or any folder; Flaccy keeps your folder structure
• Messy filenames and scene releases are identified and cleaned up automatically (AI cleanup is included in the trial and in Lifetime)
• Albums, artists, songs and playlists with fast search, flexible sorting and large artwork you can replace with your own
• Duplicate songs are listed once, and Flaccy builds smart playlists from your own listening

MADE FOR LISTENING
• Home picks up where you left off, with mixes made from your own listening and what you played on this day in years past
• Synced lyrics that fill in word by word when a song has word timing, with tap-to-seek and a timing control for songs that run off
• Share Lyrics: pick the lines you love and get a short video of them over the song itself, in four looks and four formats for Stories, posts and more
• Full controls on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island, AirPlay and a sleep timer
• Light and dark appearance, and a Now Playing screen worth looking at

BUILT FOR IPAD
• A sidebar for your library and every playlist, with Now Playing and Up Next in a column beside it
• Lyrics and the queue spread across the screen next to the artwork
• Keyboard shortcuts, the menu bar, pointer support and drag and drop: songs into Up Next or onto a playlist, audio files straight from Files

YOUR SERVER, TOO
• Play from Navidrome, Flaccy Server or any OpenSubsonic server, over your home network or Tailscale
• Songs stream without filling your iPhone or iPad and download for offline when you want them
• One purchase covers iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch

SCROBBLE EVERYTHING
• Sign in with Last.fm and every play is scrobbled, even offline, with automatic retry
• Listening charts, artist bios and a wantlist for the records you're hunting
• Year in Music: shareable story cards and a poster of your listening year

APPLE WATCH, NO PHONE NEEDED
• Sync tracks to your watch and play them offline
• A true standalone player with gapless playback, shuffle, repeat and AirPods controls
• Storage-smart sync that knows what fits

TRY IT FREE
Flaccy is free for 7 days from the first time you play your own music. After that, keep everything with a one-time Lifetime purchase, or choose the yearly plan. The yearly plan renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

Flaccy plays FLAC, ALAC, AAC, M4A, MP3, WAV, AIFF and CAF.

whatsNew:
Fixed a crash at launch for libraries where an album's discs carry different album artist tags while Group Album Editions is off.
Filter chips such as Rediscover, Recently Played and Lossless now answer at once, even in a library of thousands of songs.
Covers are square everywhere: songs, artists and search results no longer show a cover that isn't square as a rectangle or an oval.
Now Playing fits the iPhone SE, every iPhone on its side and larger text sizes, and an album shows its title, Play and Shuffle beside its tracks in landscape.
Importing a large library with big cover art uses far less memory.
Settings is rebuilt like the iPhone's own: one row for each subject that opens its page, a search field that finds any setting, and the Listening Guide is gone.
Contact Support now attaches the app's log and recent crash reports to the email, and you can remove them before sending.
